title: Exploitation of CVE-2024-35250 via Kernel Streaming IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY
id: bf558b65-add6-422c-a87d-0375da41f428
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation attempts of CVE-2024-35250 through crafted IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY requests to kernel streaming devices, indicating potential privilege escalation via untrusted pointer dereference.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2024/12/cisa-and-fbi-raise-alerts-on-exploited.html
    - https://devco.re/blog/2024/08/23/streaming-vulnerabilities-from-windows-kernel-proxying-to-kernel-part1-en/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
    - attack.privilege_escalation
    - attack.t1068
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY'
            - 'KsSynchronousIoControlDevice'
            - 'KSPROPSETID_DrmAudioStream'
        Image|endswith:
            - '\mskssrv.exe'
            - '\ks.sys'
            - '\ksthunk.sys'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools using kernel streaming APIs
    - System utilities performing legitimate device property operations
level: high

Additionally, a coordinated ransomware campaign involving DrayTek routers was executed by threat actors including Monstrous Mantis, Ruthless Mantis, and LARVA-15.

indicators.context: The name appears unencrypted in some of the malicious samples – it is the name of one of the threat actor’s components, so we decided to extend it to the APT as a whole.
The initial loader replaces the victim's legitimate Windows library 'scesrv.dll' with a malicious one of exactly the same size.
One of them – ipv4.dll – has been placed by the APT with what is, in fact, a downloader for other malicious components.
Following infection, Slingshot would load a number of modules onto the victim device, including two huge and powerful ones: Cahnadr, the kernel mode module
Canhadr, also known as NDriver, contains low-level routines for network, IO operations and so on.
GollumApp, a user mode module. The two modules are connected and able to support each other in information gathering, persistence and data exfiltration.
During our research we also found a component called KPWS that turned out to be another downloader for Slingshot components.
In turn, this infected the administrator of the router. We believe this cluster of activity started in at least 2012 and was still active at the time of this analysis (February 2018).

pipeline.attack_summary: The Lazarus group conducted two separate attacks targeting a government health ministry and a pharmaceutical company related to COVID-19 research. pipeline.attack_summary: Raspberry Robin is a worm that initially spread via infected USB drives containing LNK files disguised as folders. It uses living-off-the-land binaries like rundll32.exe and regsvr32.exe for execution and persistence, often adding itself to the RunOnce registry key. The malware has evolved to deploy other malware families such as FakeUpdates, IcedID, Bumblebee, and TrueBot, linking it to larger cybercriminal ecosystems involving groups like DEV-0651, DEV-0243, and DEV-0950.
